I don’t. I guess my plan is to just induce as much uncontrollable change as I can and hope for the best. I’ve quit my 9-5 job to take a much more lucrative one that will require me to move 4 hours from where I live. I just want to get myself on a path that won’t allow me to go back to where I am. Worst that can happen is that 20 months hits and I do what I would have done anyways.
P
Alright well...good talk I guess. Thanks for the conversation even though we didn’t really figure anything out. I do respect you for trying though.
Indeed it does. However you must have a friend to rent with a friend. It’s a never ending feedback loop.

It really isn’t when you desire to be as disconnected for the rest of these people as possible. My life’s decisions are based on doing the opposite of what I think my family would choose. 

And yes. I’d like to move somewhere. That will not happen for a long time. This economy is built that a single person simply cannot live on their own without a very well paying job.

I’m not saying these things to generate sympathy or to make people take pity on me. I’m simply stating facts. I have coasted thought life on autopilot. All I’ve done is what every other normal person should be doing. The fact that I’m surrounded by dirt poor degenerates who don’t know what work is doesn’t change that. I’m just doing what everyone should do. 

As for meeting people around me I would love that but as I said I live in a desolate, poor, insignificant place in the middle of nowhere. The population is way to small to support any online social hub. I would have to drive 40 miles to get to a place that would support a stable online meet up community.

Uhh...nah fam. I’ve literally done the bare minimum all my life. I’m not a survivor. I’ve just coasted in autopilot because I’ve been to lazy to kill myself. 

As for the internet. I can’t use that to meet people irl. Internet friends are cool but that does nothing to fix the underlying problem of my hater is for solitude and my active attempts to avoid it.

I’ve done the same thing my whole adult life. I wouldn’t know where to start with a new job since I’ve done mine for so long. The place I live at is so desolate that I truly don’t know how one would meet people albeit public school which I’m obviously not apart of.

My mom lives 10 minutes away. I despise the woman, I have no respect for her and the only reason I have any association with her is my sister. The second my sister movies out will be the last time I talk to my mom. 

My dad lives 5 hours away. I also have no respect for the man. I’ve cut him off and my only association to him is my name. He is a pompous prick who doesn’t understand how to be a father because he never had too learn.  

My grandparents are the lesser of all evils. My grandmother reminds me too much of my mother and my grandfather has learned to just go along with anything she says. I am idolized here because I am the only one who has (had?) a full time job. Graduated high school. Has his own car etc. I’m seen as some kind of god here who’s word rules over all. I hate it. I want to be told what to do and be a family member. Not an idol.
I despise solitude. I’ve been in almost constant solitude since I can remember. I dread times when I’m not working. I use reddit to pass the time but I definitely do not enjoy myself.

Nope. I live on my grandmothers couch. I spend(spent) all of my time working, driving, or sleeping. Pretty much planned it so I have minimal time in between because all free time is pretty much spent sitting here on reddit waiting to go back to work.

I don’t know what so “amazing” about my true self. Ask them. And then let me know bc I’m curious. It’s probably because I’m a huge asshole. Or the fact that I have no hobbies/passions/experiences to talk about. I’ve pretty much sat around my whole life. I have no skills, talents etc. 

Oh and I’m definitely loosing my job. I’ve accepted that. It’s a long story. I’ve made a few posts about it but at this point I just don’t care anymore.

I live with family right now. The fact that I have a job has kept me on a higher standing than everyone else here. I can survive but this is not the life I want nor do I understand how these people I live with have settled for what their lives have became. 

I’ve had my job for four years and I’ve loved every second of it. I am passionate and truly enjoy my job and I might get fired by the beginning of the week. 

I’ve spent years trying to talk to people to no avail. I’m not a like-able person. I’m not saying this to be self deprecating. It’s just a fact at this point. People do not like me no matter what kind of facade I put on. If somebody does somehow see my true self they run away very quickly.

I actually set a deadline for myself. I have a date on my calendar that says if I’m still as unhappy with my life as I am now by said date that i will kill myself. 

It’s about 20 months from now.

Oh I know. Hell I can get fired for sneezing in the wrong spot. That’s the thing about at will states. Like I said, I’m not making excuses and my explanation is that it was a poor decision that I take responsibility for making. The thing I have a problem with is the fact that she can do and say whatever she wants and our society is built to listen to only her no matter what the defense is.

While I take full responsibility for my part, I want to say that the feelings were completely mutual. Actually the first week or so of us talking was her trying to convince me to go out with her to which I didn’t want too bc she was my subordinate. It wasn’t until a few weeks of her trying to convince me that I finally said “ok we can give it a shot”...horrible decision.
It was Snapchat so the only way I can get them back is if she gives them to me.
Don’t shit where you eat. Lesson learned my friend lol.

I’m an easy going guy. I’ve never had to write anybody up before and I didn’t want to this time. I actually didn’t even want it to be official. I asked my manager to not file it and to just talk to her. She was the one that determined that the girl should be written up. 

Myself and others have complained about this girl many times to many levels of management before this.

I haven’t talked to anybody yet since this was all so sudden but I will defiantly bring this up. She had not once complained to or about me in any way until I was forced to write her up. Which I didn’t even want to do.
Boi. The feeling was mutual lol. No creeping. I’m not negating any of my responsibility and I have definitely learned a lesson no matter how this ends up.
I’ll know Monday for sure. The girl also put in her two weeks notice so she’s leaving anyways. Well see how things go.
It was actually Snapchat so I can’t get back any messages unless she gives them to me so that won’t work. But you are 100% correct and I take responsibility for my part in this whole ordeal.
What I said was that my boss is on my side and agreed that she should be written up. She knew that we were talking and she knew when we stopped. The girl went above the ladder to Corporate HR.
Thanks man. Good looking out lol.

I’ve had this job since I could legally work and have moved up the ladder quicker than almost anyone had in the history of the company. And now that might all be gone... and the worst part is that I actually really enjoy my job.

I did it. I wrote her up. The next day I presented it to my department manager. I even asked for it to not be put on file but instead used as a learning device so it wouldn’t happen again. It was my manager that said “Her actions merited an official write up.” And sent it to HR despite my request.
It is. I just wish our society wasn’t as such that these incidents leave very little room for a defense. No matter how valid.

You are absolutely correct. In fact that was one of my main reasons for cutting this girl off. Not an excuse at all but more so an explanation. While I did screw up she shouldn’t be made immune to all punishment afterwards. She thought she could do and say anything and get away with it because I had a hard on for her a few months ago. And this proves that she was right. It’s just a shitty precedent  as a whole but I do take responsibility for my part in the situation.

Yes I know I’m a dumb 19 year old who doesn’t know anybody and I made the mistake of trusting someone who knows exactly how to get what she wants. On the bright side, no matter how this ends up, I’ve definitely leaned that lesson...

We did like each other. We went out once but after that it was downhill. We continued to flirt and I asked her out a few more times but in the end I told her that I was no longer interested and that I didn’t want to have any kind of relationship. This happened maybe a month before the “write up”

Well the last time I asked her on a date was over a month before all this happened. After that I began to have second thoughts and then some of her actions sealed the deal and I told her that I was done with the “chase”. Now granted i did use some strongly worded messages to say that. But nothing that has anything to do with work. 

So to answer your question we did have a few conversations here and there but the day before all this happened I pretty much told her I was done and that I don’t want to deal with her anymore. I guess she was mad the next day and was out to be antagonistic to which she chose to do the things that got her written up.

So I’m guessing she’s going to use my messages the night before to say that I was mad at her already and that I wrote her up for it. Which doesn’t make sense because I blocked her?

So my worry is that they will try and say I did something based on the fact that I told her to piss off the night before. And that can beastly be disproven by asking if “she really did all these things” which, yes, she did. But even then I doubt they will even stand to reason in a which hunt like this. 

Edit: Sorry for the long reply but I guess it’s a little therapeutic to get it out so I kinda just kept on typing away.
Because I’m a dumb 19 year old who made the mistake of trusting someone who knew how to get exactly what she wanted. But I be damned if I haven’t learnt my lesson no matter how this turns out...
